entry.content:
Tama is the most powerful Ninja in the kingdom. She also has no interest in being Queen. When the carefree Nekojin princess and her cunning Foxkin advisor Saki return to Drestor after their ordeal in the ancient ruins of Muosil, they expect a moment of peace. Instead, they walk into a political storm! The Regent Alissa has arrived with her royal guards demanding the reluctant princess to claim her throne for the sake of the kingdom. As Tama struggles to accept a crown she never wanted, Saki learns that for all her charm, she is utterly helpless when it comes to love. When the ancient dragon Mantheria makes her move, Tama must confront a foe even she cannot defeat alone. With Saki distracted and the upcoming Coronation. How will these two handle the future?

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.content:
Tama is a ninja who speaks in the third person, hates wearing clothes, and considers her pet boar Jiggle a tactical asset. She is also, apparently, the lost princess of a kingdom she has never heard of and the living avatar of the Goddess of Creation. She would rather fight goblins. Saki is a Kitsune who has spent her entire life manipulating everyone around her. She thought she was beyond caring about anyone. Then she met Tama. Together, an illiterate cat-girl and a traumatized fox-girl stumble through goblin armies, undead liches, and ancient dragons. Then discover that the hardest enemy to defeat is paperwork. Along the way they will collect a divine water spirit who wants to be a pet, an elf child who wants to be a weapon, and a princess who wants to be a slave. Her Majesty, Tamaneko is a progression fantasy about found family, the cost of strength, and learning that sometimes the person you needed was already looking for you.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

Tama's worst nightmare has come true. Separated from Saki and stranded in the ruined underwater city of Muosil, Tama finds herself facing an impossible choice. Saki awakens alone in an ancient temple. She is not alone. A divine water spirit named Anna has claimed her as a host and wants to be the best of friends. As Tama struggles to understand her new responsibility and Saki fights to control a being that can possess anyone at will, the two friends must navigate goblin politics, ancient ruins, and the truth about Tama's royal heritage.

entry.content:
Tama is about to become Queen. She would rather fight a dragon. Unfortunately, she may have to do both. The capital is waiting for its new ruler, and Tama wants absolutely nothing to do with thrones, ceremonies, politics, or paperwork. She is a ninja. Ninjas fight monsters, protect people, and eat fries. Queens apparently have meetings. While Saki struggles to prepare the kingdom for Tama’s coronation, things begin going very wrong. A deadly plague is spreading through the capital. Powerful nobles are already testing the future Queen. An enemy from Tama’s past has returned. And somewhere in the shadows, the dragon Manna is still watching. She believes Tama was destined for greatness. Tama disagrees. But with the coronation getting closer and the people she loves being dragged into danger, avoiding the throne may no longer be an option. Her Majesty, Tamaneko is finally getting her Queen. Whether the kingdom survives the experience is another matter.

Platforms: Kindle

entry.content:
Her Majesty, Tamaneko is finally Queen. After the events over the last few days, Saki is ready for a vacation. Sadly, life has other plans. The Plague is still a problem, the caldera is now visible to a much bigger world, and the Tamaneko Ward still looms overhead. Suffice to say, Saki has her work cut out for her. So when Manna, whom she thought dead, shows up in the castle claiming she can rekindle the shrine and hide the caldera once more, Tama and Saki must make a choice. Do they trust the ancient monster? Do they really have a choice?

Platforms: Kindle

entry.content:
After the events at the Shrine of Creation, Saki is finally trying to put her life back together. Naturally, that lasts about five minutes. Despite the shrine’s restoration, a fleet of more than one hundred ships is approaching the caldera. The kingdom has barely had time to breathe, and now war may be coming straight to its doorstep. After the usual derailed meeting, the party manages to capture one of the fleet’s officers. What they discover is worse than expected. The officer is Aurelia, a princess of the invading empire. Saki quickly charms what information she can out of her, and she does not like what she hears. War is on the horizon. Tama has only recently become Queen, and now she must learn how to wage one. But really, what else is new for a Tamaneko?

Platforms: Kindle

entry.content:
Xanari Telis died proving humanity wrong. After creating the world's first truly sentient artificial life, the brilliant young inventor awakens in Xanrea, a world of magic, monsters, and ancient gods. Armed with an obsessive mind, revolutionary rune concepts, and absolutely catastrophic social skills, Xan begins experimenting with magic the same way he once approached engineering. What starts as a simple attempt to create companionship quickly spirals into something far larger as Xan unintentionally overturns magical theory, terrifies priestesses, destabilizes economies, and lays the foundation for creations the world was never meant to possess. Accompanied by Tina, a Nekojin priestess rapidly losing control of her life, Xan journeys across Xanrea in search of knowledge, materials, and answers. But while kingdoms chase power and heroes fight monsters… Xan is quietly building something that may outlast them all.

Platforms:

I could reach out and take them or change them to be better. When I took mommy's blue thing she fell down and stopped moving. I put it back and she got up. I
entry.content:
My parents considered me an accident, but useful as a tax write-off. When I turned six, I started being able to see blue things inside people. I could reach out and take them or change them to be better. When I took mommy's blue thing she fell down and stopped moving. I put it back and she got up. I realized when I did things to the blue thing, mommy started doing what I wanted. Then I met Mark. I knew in an instant it was him, my perfect husband. There were a few small flaws, but mommy helped me fix them. We were going to find him a new body, an even better one, and we would be married and I would be the perfect wife! At least, that was the plan. It's been fifteen years and Mark still hasn't chosen a body. He uses mine.

Platforms: Gumroad · Gumroad

He defeated an ancient dragon on his first day, cleared eighty goblins in a single afternoon, and dismantled an entire bandit operation without breaking a sweat. None of that is true. The dragon died because he fell down. The g
entry.content:
Lucas the Grand Strategist is the most feared adventurer in the kingdom. He defeated an ancient dragon on his first day, cleared eighty goblins in a single afternoon, and dismantled an entire bandit operation without breaking a sweat. None of that is true. The dragon died because he fell down. The goblins died because he ran in circles. The bandits died because he threw something out of spite and didn't know what it was. Unfortunately nobody believes him. Not the elf ranger who has decided she is on a grand romantic adventure with a tactical genius. Not the Nekojin who keeps showing up in his room at night, who he is absolutely certain is an assassin. Not the adventurers guild who keeps giving him quests he doesn't understand. And certainly not the Demon Queen, who will one day face him in single combat and lose in a way she will never be able to adequately explain. Lucas just wants to survive long enough to figure out why everyone in this world is trying to either kill him or marry him. He is not lucky enough for either.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

There is just one tiny problem: "The Hero" has died countless times in the Toybox. He hates it, he hates them, and he wants t
entry.content:
This is the lullaby sung to the residents of the Toybox from the moment they are born: The Hero is perfect, The Hero is grand. He is less a person and more a force of nature. There is just one tiny problem: "The Hero" has died countless times in the Toybox. He hates it, he hates them, and he wants to escape more than anything. Except there is no escape. The Toybox runs on broken quests, worse incentives, and mechanics that should not exist. Then one day, during a random iteration like any other, one of the NPCs wakes up. She was written to serve, to adore, to worship: a perfect NPC in a perfect role, never meant to awaken to the horrors of the Toybox. But she did. Now she's caught between what she was programmed to feel and what she actually feels. In a world built on broken mechanics, she might be the most broken of all. Content Warning: This story contains explicit sexual content, dubious consent that evolves into agency, psychological horror, existential themes, and meta commentary on game mechanics and player ethics.

Platforms: Gumroad · Kindle

entry.content:
Timothy "Acros" Dram conquered the world for one woman, Rose. He never found her. He enslaved gods, broke kingdoms, and killed millions. As he stood on a rooftop watching a statue built in her image, a mysterious figure appeared and offered him a chance to go back and try again. Acros took it without a second thought. Except the moment he arrived, he learned that the Rose he knew was fake: the Goddess of Chaos, Trixiarie, had been wearing her face. Trixiarie claimed Rose was never real. Everything he did, everything he destroyed, was for nothing. Acros refuses to believe that. There must be more going on. Now a seer is telling him to save the world if he wants his answers. Was Rose real? The answer might break him. But Acros is going to find out, even if it kills him. Just one tiny problem: Acros is now a level-four nobody with an evil spirit attached to him. Eh, minor setback.
